question: Should OpenClaw support native per-task model hints in HEARTBEAT.md, or should heartbeat model routing remain per-turn and be handled through plugins or the cron/job-level override track?
rationale: The missing capability is source-proven, but the fix changes public task-file syntax, provider/model precedence, and session-state behavior, so automation should not choose the product contract.

options.title: Fold into scheduled-job routing
options.body: Use the open cron/job-level model override track as the canonical scheduled-work model selection path and avoid adding another HEARTBEAT.md-specific syntax until cron and heartbeat semantics converge.

options.title: Add native task hints
options.body: Define model/provider fields in HEARTBEAT.md tasks and split due-task execution by effective model with explicit timestamp and session-state rules.

options.title: Keep whole-turn plugin routing
options.body: Document that heartbeat ticks are one model-routed turn and that before_model_resolve or ClawHub plugins may escalate the whole run, not individual tasks.

recommendation.title: Fold into scheduled-job routing
recommendation.body: Use the open cron/job-level model override track as the canonical scheduled-work model selection path and avoid adding another HEARTBEAT.md-specific syntax until cron and heartbeat semantics converge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest product-boundary signal from prior dynamic model-routing decisions and the hook split that defines the current plugin seam.
